ratings.note: Frequency 1: only skippers who go Back to the boat step meet it, a minority of passes through the critical booking journey. Impact 2: all four fields, including the 9-digit MMSI, must be re-typed on a phone, often one-handed on board, with autofill disabled; the details are known to the skipper so not impact 3. Persistence 2: it recurs on every return and learning cannot avoid it. Matches s = 3.
